_note: hand-authored catalogue of famous railway viaducts and tunnels (no third-party licence); generated by tools/make_rail_drama_1940.py. Positions are real WGS84 coordinates from the cited per-record source. The bulk of the programme's viaducts and tunnels are DERIVED from the terrain at runtime (see scripts/ground/rail_kit.gd); this file pins the famous ones to their real positions.
